reese-style-detuned-bass.code:
$: stack(
  note("c2 c2 eb2 g1").s("sawtooth"),
  note("c2 c2 eb2 g1").s("sawtooth").add(note(0.12))
).hpf(30).lpf(400).lpq(8).attack(0.005).gain(0.38)
reese-style-detuned-bass.notes: the `add(note(0.12))` detune is UNVERIFIED (it is a semitone offset via documented `add`). A true supersaw is `s("supersaw")`, which appears in a documented example. Keep `lpq` below about 15 for stability (judgement, UNVERIFIED).
reese-style-detuned-bass.expr:
stack(
  note("c2 c2 eb2 g1").s("sawtooth"),
  note("c2 c2 eb2 g1").s("sawtooth").add(note(0.12))
).hpf(30).lpf(400).lpq(8).attack(0.005).gain(0.38)

sub-bass.notes: low-pass keeps it sub. Remove the filter for purer sine.

filter-sweep-build.notes: `sine.slow(8).range(200,4000)` is a signal on `lpf`. Cutoff is 0 to 20000 Hz.

riser.notes: `saw.slow(8)` runs 0 to 1 over 8 cycles, so the riser fades in.

breakdown-drop-arrangement-over-bars.notes: `arrange([cycles, pattern], ...)` syntax is verified from the Strudel FAQ mirror (https://warm.strudel.cc/learn/faq). Confirm on strudel.cc. `setcpm(BPM/4)` for 4/4.

half-time.notes: one kick and one snare per cycle; cycle length is one bar at the set tempo. Use `.slow(2)` on the hat to thin it.
half-time.error: needs a sample bank, none loaded in the headless renderer: [webaudio] error: sound RolandTR808_bd not found! Is it loaded?

call-and-response.code:
$: note("<[c4 e4 g4 e4] ~>").s("triangle").room(0.3)
$: note("<~ [g4 a4 b4 c5]>").s("square").gain(0.5)
call-and-response.notes: alternation `< >` swaps the phrase and answer each cycle.
call-and-response.expr:
stack(
  note("<[c4 e4 g4 e4] ~>").s("triangle").room(0.3),
  note("<~ [g4 a4 b4 c5]>").s("square").gain(0.5)
)

minor-motif.notes: `scale("A:minor")` uses root:scale syntax from the tonal page. Numbers index the scale.

chord-stabs.notes: `^` marks major seventh. `decay` and `sustain(0)` cut each chord short.

sidechain-pump.notes: the pattern on `orbit(2)` is the one that ducks. Structure taken from the duck section of https://strudel.cc/learn/effects/. Ducked layer is listed first: otherwise superdough reports 'duck target orbit 2 does not exist'. The offline renderer also logs a harmless t=0 stop-time warning for ducking (ignored by the verifier).
sidechain-pump.error: needs a sample bank, none loaded in the headless renderer: [webaudio] error: sound bd not found! Is it loaded?

fade-out.notes: `gain` accepts a pattern, so each cycle drops one step. Use `saw.range(1,0).slow(8)` for a smooth fade (signal form documented on https://strudel.cc/learn/signals/).

synth-kick.notes: Pitch envelope drops 24 semitones in 0.08 s; decay cuts the tail. Same idea as the kick mapping in docs/STRUDEL_PORT.md. Tuned to G1 (49 Hz) so the body sits above the 30 Hz high-pass.

synth-hat-offbeat.notes: `white` is the built-in noise source. hpf keeps only the top; decay/sustain(0) make it short.

synth-backbeat.notes: Two-step bar, so the burst lands on the second half (a half-time feel).

syncopated-bass.notes: Rests (`~`) make the groove; lower the lpf for darker.

supersaw-pad.notes: `s("supersaw")` is in a documented example; `unison`, `detune`, `spread` come from docs/STRUDEL_PORT.md (not on the fetched official pages).

pluck.notes: `lpenv` is the filter envelope depth; lpa/lpd its attack/decay.

chord-progression.notes: `^` = major seventh. `voicing()` picks chord tones near a default anchor.

root-bass.notes: Match the roots to the chord recipe above.

delay-echo.notes: delay = send level, delaytime in seconds, feedback 0 to 1 (below 1).

stereo-jux.notes: `jux` applies a function to the right channel only. `rev` appears in a jux example only.

dry-tight.notes: Contrast with the big reverb recipe.

tremolo-pad.notes: tremolo speed in Hz; tremolodepth amount; tremoloshape("sine") keeps the wobble smooth (the default shape is a ramp, which clicks).

vowel-voice.code: $: note("c3 eb3 g3 eb3").s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o>").gain(0.5)
vowel-voice.notes: `vowel` is a formant filter, not a sampled voice.
vowel-voice.expr: note("c3 eb3 g3 eb3").s("sawtooth").vowel("<a e i o>").gain(0.5)

fm-bell.notes: fm = modulation index, fmh = harmonicity ratio.

lofi-crunch.notes: crush 1 to 16 bits (lower = rougher); coarse divides the sample rate.

perlin-drift.notes: perlin = smooth noise 0..1; `.range` scales it. The cutoff is read once per note.

sidechain-synth.notes: The pattern on orbit 2 is the one that ducks. Ducked layer is listed first: otherwise superdough reports 'duck target orbit 2 does not exist'. The offline renderer also logs a harmless t=0 stop-time warning for ducking (ignored by the verifier).

build-drop.notes: `arrange([cycles, pattern], ...)` from the FAQ mirror. Not stackable in the compose page (it has top-level statements).

layers-in.notes: `mask` with a `<>` pattern switches a layer on/off per cycle (used by docs/STRUDEL_PORT.md; not on the fetched official pages).

filter-open-intro.notes: A `<>` list on `lpf` is one value per cycle.

random-thin.notes: `?` removes events at random (50%); `?0.2` removes fewer.

polymeter.code: $: note("{c3 eb3 g3, c2 g2 bb2 d3}%4").s("triangle").hpf(60).gain(0.5)
polymeter.notes: Curly braces with `%steps`; not on the fetched official pages.
polymeter.expr: note("{c3 eb3 g3, c2 g2 bb2 d3}%4").s("triangle").hpf(60).gain(0.5)

dark-drone.notes: Low root, low cutoff, slow movement.

tense-riser.notes: Pitch envelope attack stretches the climb. Check by ear: panchor/pcurve behaviour is documented loosely.
